observations: Used metal gearbox/transmission assembly sitting among other engine parts in a cluttered parts yard or workshop.
Bell housing is open, exposing the flex plate/torque converter mounting face; output shaft visible at the front.
Dusty, oily exterior with hoses and wires still attached; no readable brand plate or model number visible in any photo.
White sticker present on casing but text is illegible.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC' appears across all three photos.
Seller sent a text reply claiming personal testing yesterday but provided no new photo, video, or document.

Engine cylinder count cannot be determined from exterior gearbox photos.
No origin documents, shipping papers, or Belgium markings visible in photos.
Seller says tested yesterday but no test video, shifting demonstration, or operational proof shown.
No audio or internal inspection provided.
No odometer, service history, or mileage proof visible.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; no new photo, video, or document was sent.

risks.risk: Internal gears, bearings, or synchronizers may be damaged or worn out.
risks.proof: Video of input shaft rotating and gears engaging, or borescope clip of the interior.

risks.risk: Unit may not fit a Ford Fusion 4-cylinder application.
risks.proof: Close-up of a readable part number plate or a screenshot cross-referencing the part to Ford Fusion 4-cylinder.

risks.risk: Unit may be manual rather than automatic.
risks.proof: Clear photo showing whether a torque converter (automatic) or clutch assembly (manual) is present.

risks.risk: Seals or gaskets may leak fluid.
risks.proof: Clean underside photo after degreasing, or a pressure/leak test clip.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any identification plate or sticker on the gearbox casing.
Video showing the input shaft turning and gears engaging.
Photo confirming automatic torque converter versus manual clutch assembly.
Screenshot of the part number matched to a Ford Fusion 4-cylinder.
response.reason: The item is visibly a used car gearbox; the seller's verbal assurance adds no visual proof, so it remains priced at worst case as non-working with unverified fitment.
